features.name: log_content_length
features.description: Log-scaled article token count for smooth linear scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed length distribution into a linearly separable scale.

features.name: lexical_richness_score
features.description: Composite vocabulary diversity blending unique-token and non-stop-unique ratios.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized signal that linearly separates dense vs sparse vocabulary articles.

features.name: media_density
features.description: Total images plus videos normalized by article length.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity proxy distinguishing media-heavy entertainment/tech from text-heavy world/business.

features.name: image_to_video_balance
features.description: Relative balance between images and videos, scaled to [-1,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps linear margin separate visual-image channels (lifestyle) from video-heavy ones (entertainment).

features.name: self_link_ratio
features.description: Share of hyperlinks pointing to self-references.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures internal-linking culture that differs across publishing verticals.

features.name: log_hrefs
features.description: Log-scaled total hyperlinks for smoother linear scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew of href counts beneficial to linear/SVM margins.

features.name: sentiment_intensity
features.description: Absolute sentiment polarity capturing emotional strength.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity feature linearly separating dry vs emotive verticals.

features.name: positive_negative_gap
features.description: Difference between positive and negative word rates.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection separating upbeat lifestyle/socmed from negative-laden world news.

features.name: subjectivity_x_polarity
features.description: Interaction between subjectivity and absolute polarity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite useful for SVM margins discriminating opinionated channels.

features.name: avg_token_length_z
features.description: Standardized average token length using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximately linear standardized feature improving SVM scaling.

features.name: title_brevity_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of how concise and headline-like the article_title is (0 = long verbose, 1 = punchy short headline).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures stylistic title compactness that varies by channel (tech/socmed favor punchier titles).

features.name: title_listicle_tone
features.description: Semantic judgment of whether the article_title exhibits listicle/clickbait tone (e.g., numeric lists, 'how to', 'top N'), scored 0=none to 1=strong listicle.
features.expected_model_benefit: Strong stylistic indicator separating socmed/lifestyle/entertainment from business/world news.
